newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady on select buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady on select buying.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were steady on Sunday amid selective buying by spinners and are likely to fall owing to oversupply, dealers said.

"Overall the market is bearish," dealer Nasim Usman said. "There was some selective buying, but spinners are short of cash and huge stocks are piling up at ginneries, which could pull the prices down."
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,275 rupees ($56.56) per maund (37.32 kg) and the MNH-93 at 2,250 rupees, the dealers said.
